objective: Develop the standalone Chinese asset-delivery workbench from 1.0 into a production-ready 1.1 with visual project Profile authoring, deeper deterministic delivery rules, reproducible real-world demos, Windows distribution and public release evidence.

milestones.outcome: Ship the read-only audit MVP and its safety evidence.
Harden report interoperability and large-delivery behavior.
Provide reproducible production-like demo assets and a complete recording tutorial.
Ship the interactive read-only delivery review workbench.
Ship safe organization, project history and public GitHub release evidence.
Let users create, validate, save and reuse versioned project Profiles without editing JSON.
Add evidence-backed deterministic rules for realistic delivery structure and texture sets.
Ship a verified Windows distribution and public 1.1 release evidence.

nextSlice.outcome: Ship a versioned Windows 1.1 distribution that starts without a developer checkout, survives clean install and upgrade checks, reproduces the documented demos and has public release evidence.
nonGoals: Modify audited delivery files outside an explicitly approved organization demo copy
Inspect DCC scene topology or material networks
Claim code signing without a real certificate
acceptance: Project, capability manifest, executable metadata and documentation consistently identify version 1.1.0
A reproducible Windows build produces a standalone Chinese desktop distribution and checksums without requiring a developer checkout or system Python at runtime
Clean-machine-style verification launches the packaged GUI twice with focus/PID isolation, runs a packaged golden audit and confirms all owned processes close
Wheel clean install, portable distribution and source checkout all pass the same contract, capability, five-scenario read-only and approved-organization evidence
Upgrade from the documented 1.0 user-data layout preserves audit history and does not write into delivery fixtures; uninstall and data-retention boundaries are documented and tested where automatable
README, installation guide and recording tutorial let a new user install, launch and reproduce success, failure, boundary and safe-organization workflows
Six to ten actual Chinese screenshots are current, visually inspected and linked from the README/tutorial
A 1.1 release audit records artifact names, SHA-256, platform, Python/Qt versions, tests, limitations and exact public GitHub release identity
Public GitHub main and the 1.1 release/tag contain only verified claims and repository secrets scan is clean

guardrails: Chinese UI, README, tutorials and screenshot captions are the default deliverables
Never mutate immutable demo/scenarios fixtures; organization demos operate on generated work copies
Demo assets are synthetic or license-audited and redistributable
Every showcase release includes multiple actual-run screenshots covering success, failure, boundary and before/after states
Mutation requires dry-run, collision checks, explicit confirmation, rollback and post-run verification
Material networks and DCC scene adapters remain out of scope until separately justified
